youtube_title: What is System Stress? | CS 5254 Week 12
summary: Stress exposes the point where added load stops improving throughput and starts breaking the system.
youtube_description:
Stress exposes the point where added load stops improving throughput and starts breaking the system. The lecture frames contention, saturation, and operational limits as the pressure that reveals whether the design can still make progress.

This CS 5254 Week 12 lecture explores system stress and its impact on concurrent system design.

#Concurrency #SystemDesign #SoftwareEngineering #CS5254
